issues.location: first Church-numeral application in the search procedure
issues.finding:
The frozen formula writes 
um m_0 and 
um m_{n-1} without grouped arguments. The macro takes one mandatory argument, so the subscripts fall outside the numeral overline. The same proof later groups both subscripts in 
um{m_0} and 
um{m_{n-1}}.
issues.proposed_resolution: Group the full subscripted variables as \num{m_0} and \num{m_{n-1}} in the target, matching the later expression; preserve all other symbols.

translation_treatment: The Javanese proof groups the two numeral arguments in its first search expression. QA v14 compares against an exact source view and passes all structural checks; reader build and visual readback remain pending.
